answer: For an inherited car, bring the death certificate plus either court letters naming you executor or administrator of the estate, or, for a small estate that doesn't go through probate court, the heir and estate affidavit (form NW-EST-1) signed by the heir. If there are several heirs, the executor signs, or every heir signs NW-EST-1. Because there's still a loan on the car, the lender holds the title, so the lost-title process for paid-off cars doesn't apply. The help center doesn't include the details of selling a car that still has a loan on it, so please contact a store for the rest of what you'll need.
